records.supported_name_scope: The dominant elongated mapped waterbody is associated with Artillery Lake, corroborated by independent park context. This does not establish that the same name covers every point of the generalized polygon.

The extra-scope concern follows visible water shapes, not merely a text box crossing the polygon.
records.whole_polygon_conclusion: Possible additional downstream water extent remains unresolved. The map and park flyer do not establish a single official name for the whole baseline polygon.
